afon.name: Afon
afon.description: Afon is a browser from M-Tech Industries focused on dependable, privacy-conscious browsing for personal and managed environments.

testing.feedback: Report issues to support@m-techindustries.com with the version, platform, device, and a short description of what happened.

releases.summary: Separated browser protection controls and improved reliability when applying protection and navigation decisions.
whatsNew: Separated Tracker and Ad Protection from Link Protection
Separated URL Safety and certificate-warning behavior from the other protection controls
Added clearer independent settings for tracker and link protection
fixes: Improved navigation reliability when protection settings change
Reduced unintended interaction between tracker exceptions and link handling
Improved consistency when applying protection decisions during navigation
Improved stale navigation cleanup and Back and Forward state handling
General performance and reliability fixes

releases.summary: Added Share Afon and new themes while improving navigation, History, warning explanations, and browsing recovery.
whatsNew: Added Share Afon links through the Android share sheet
Added Reading Room, Afterglow 86, Ember, Tidal, Zephyr, and Terrene themes
Improved one-time Allow Once navigation for eligible Strict-mode links
fixes: Improved browsing, search, reload, tab, and navigation reliability
Improved handling of links delivered to Afon from other applications
Improved Back, Home, and safe-page recovery
Improved active-tab History isolation and reduced unnecessary tab reloads
Clarified warning reasons and available recovery actions
Clarified the difference between retrying normally and proceeding through an eligible certificate warning
Displayed recognizable Google, DuckDuckGo, and Bing searches more clearly in normal History
Combined equivalent normal searches into one visible History entry
Retired the legacy Annoyance Intelligence behavior to reduce unwanted interference with ordinary browsing
Improved theme compatibility, previews, and text contrast

releases.summary: Improved browser stability, navigation recovery, and handling of recurring page interruptions.
whatsNew: Refined Annoyance Intelligence to respond more cautiously to recurring page interruptions
fixes: Improved overall browser stability and performance
Improved navigation and session recovery after interrupted or failed page loads
Improved Back and Home recovery from blocked pages
Improved external-link and application handling
Prevented recovery from repeatedly returning to the same blocked external link
Improved handling of restored tabs and browsing sessions
Improved theme compatibility across app versions
General bug fixes and reliability improvements

releases.summary: Improved Android Back and Forward behavior across page loads, tabs, overlays, and recovery screens.
whatsNew: Added active-tab navigation safeguards for Back and Forward
Added improved recovery context for Strict navigation
Added more detailed privacy-safe navigation diagnostics
fixes: Fixed an Android Back race while a page navigation was pending
Kept Back and Forward History isolated to each tab
Prevented navigation History from carrying across tabs
Improved Back behavior for searches, redirects, and modern single-page websites
Improved dismissal of menus, sheets, and page overlays before navigating away
Reduced false overlay detection caused by normal page content
Improved blocked-page, failed-page, and safe-page recovery
Improved navigation after restoring previously open tabs

releases.summary: Strengthened navigation protection and added better recovery from unwanted redirects, popups, and stuck pages.
whatsNew: Added safer handling for links opened in Afon from other applications
Added emergency recovery for pages that appear stuck or unresponsive
Added Back to Safe Page recovery when normal browser History is unavailable
Added a long-press Refresh escape for difficult page states
fixes: Strengthened protection against unwanted redirects and tab takeovers
Improved popup and new-window containment
Improved Android Back behavior while pages are loading
Improved blocked-page and page-failure recovery
Fixed History and last-safe-page retention after Save History was disabled
Improved Private Session cleanup
Improved privacy-safe diagnostics using host-level information

releases.summary: Added working theme redemption and improved external-application handling.
whatsNew: Added theme-code redemption for the Smoke and Nebula themes
Added permission prompts before supported links open another application
fixes: Improved remote theme validation and installation
Improved theme activation persistence
Improved Theme Manager reliability
Kept the current theme unchanged when theme validation or installation could not complete
Improved handling when the theme service was unavailable

releases.summary: Introduced Afon's Theme Manager and the first tester-visible custom theme experience.
whatsNew: Added Theme Manager to Appearance settings
Added Classic and Nebula theme selection
Added theme colors and visual styling throughout the browser
Added support for installing compatible theme packages
fixes: Improved the Appearance settings layout
Improved the Tracker and Ad Protection settings layout
Preserved Classic Light and Classic Dark appearance when switching themes
Improved theme package validation and fallback behavior
Improved Nebula readability and menu styling
Improved Enhanced protection behavior and blocked-content cleanup

releases.testingStatus: Previous Android release; latest recorded iOS testing build
releases.summary: Improved privacy controls, site exception handling, diagnostics, and Android compatibility.
whatsNew: Fixed Enhanced Privacy selection on Android
Improved YouTube compatibility through trusted in-browser navigation handling
Added expanded privacy-safe page failure diagnostics
Improved tracker exception handling and validation
fixes: Fixed site protection exception persistence
Fixed Enhanced Privacy selection state
Improved subresource error handling
Improved diagnostics reporting reliability
knownIssues: Some websites may experience intermittent Android WebView compatibility issues

releases.summary: Privacy improvements, diagnostics reporting, and stability enhancements.
whatsNew: Improved Private Session behavior and persistence

releases.summary: Migration from Aevon Browser to Afon Browser.
fixes: Corrected Private Session persistence behavior
Improved browsing mode restoration

whatsNew: Address bar search and URL handling
